Without an account, everything is stored only on this device. Nothing is sent over the internet.
With an account, routine, boards, photos and saved phrases are in your account, with a copy on this device to work without internet.
The count of communication use always stays only on this device. What you said is never recorded.
A caregiver only sees what you allow, and you can end the link at any time. Saved phrases are never shared.
Your routine, your boards and your saved phrases on this device will be erased. This cannot be undone.
ori helps you organize the day, communicate and care, with or without internet.

ori keeps your routine and your communication so it can work for you. Without an account, everything stays only on this device. With an account, it is kept with Google Firebase (in Brazil) and only you and the people you authorize see it. There are no ads, and the data is never sold. You can download a copy or delete everything at any time, in Settings > Privacy.

Withdrawing consent means deleting your data: use the button below. After that, ori asks for consent again if you use it again.
The account and everything in it will be deleted: profile, photo, routine, boards, phrases, preferences and links. This cannot be undone. If you want, download a copy first.
For security, sign out and sign in again; then delete the account. Nothing was deleted.
Made as a final course project of Etec da Zona Leste by Matheus Mendonça de Lima, Nicollas Lopes Costa and Mariana Moreira dos Santos. Contact: matheusmendima03@gmail.com

ori is not a medical device. It supports organization and communication, but it does not diagnose, treat or replace health professionals, therapists or speech therapists. Do not use ori as the only means of communication in emergencies.
Emoji are drawn by your device\'s font; ori ships no third-party symbol pictures.
